tldr: 🔥 Claude Opus 5 continues to dominate benchmarks with zero-percent prompt injection breakthrough, while OpenAI ships three major launches: ChatGPT Voice on desktop (full-duplex GPT-Live + Codex), ChatGPT Health to all US users, and Presence enterprise agent service. Alibaba Qwen drops a multimodal hat trick — Image-3.0, Audio-3.0-TTS, and Audio-3.0-Realtime. Zo Computer adds GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna with 1M context support. DeepSeek's V4 legacy API cutoff takes effect — hard stop, no fallback routing. Hermes Agent credential firewall and TLDraw offline skill go live. Kimi K3 GPU demand remains maxed with open weights promised July 27. YC publishes Fall 2026 RFS including defense and AI tutoring. A viral essay argues open-weight AI is having its 'Kubernetes moment.' Anthropic's Dario Amodei urges G7 unity on AI governance amid escalating US export tensions.

articles.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Voice on Desktop — Full-Duplex GPT-Live with Codex Control
articles.summary: GPT-Live full-duplex voice arrives on macOS desktop. Control Codex and ChatGPT Work hands-free — create PRs, debug, manage threads by voice. Appshots for screen context.

articles.title: ChatGPT Health Launches to All US Users Over 18
articles.summary: Connects Apple Health, medical records, MyFitnessPal for personalized health insights. Over 300M health queries per week. Major expansion into consumer health AI.

articles.title: OpenAI Presence — Enterprise AI Agents Managed by Forward Deployed Engineers
articles.summary: Managed enterprise agent service resolving 75% of support issues without human assistance. BBVA, SoftBank, IAG as design partners. New revenue model for OpenAI.

articles.title: OpenAI Strengthens Biodefense Access with Rosalind Initiative
articles.summary: Expands trusted GPT-Rosalind access to vetted developers and US government partners advancing biodefense, public health, and pandemic preparedness.

articles.title: Boston Children's Hospital Uses OpenAI to Diagnose 40+ Rare Diseases
articles.summary: Boston Children's Hospital uses OpenAI technology to improve patient care and help diagnose more than 40 rare disease cases, reducing operational burden.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Legacy API Cutoff Takes Effect — Hard Stop, No Fallback
articles.summary: deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner retired permanently. All API users must migrate to deepseek-v4-pro or deepseek-v4-flash. No backward compatibility.

articles.title: Alibaba Qwen-Image-3.0 — Text-to-Image with 4.5K Token Rich Content
articles.summary: Generates rich content up to 4.5K tokens, authentic details down to 10px text, deep knowledge across 12 languages and 20 font styles in one step.

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS — Studio-Grade Text-to-Speech in Two Flavors
articles.summary: Flash for real-time interaction, Plus for high-quality generation. Fine-grained inline tags for whisper, anger, breaths, laughs. Free-style natural language control.

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime — Conversational Model with Agent Tools
articles.summary: Real-time conversational model with complex reasoning, agent tool integration, and lifelike dialogue. Supports 16 languages and 20 Chinese dialects.

articles.title: Zo Computer Adds GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, Luna — Terra/Luna Get 1M Context
articles.summary: Zo adds OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family. Terra and Luna support 1M-token context windows. Expanding hosted model options for AI agent workloads.

articles.title: Zo Computer Rebuilds Chat Rendering for Smooth Long Conversations
articles.summary: Rebuilt rendering pipeline so streaming replies stay smooth regardless of conversation length. Major UX improvement for power users.

articles.title: Hermes Agent v0.19.0 Credential Firewall — Real Keys Never Enter Sandbox
articles.summary: Security feature: stand-in tokens only enter Docker sandboxes. Compromised sandbox tokens are useless elsewhere. Next-level agent security architecture.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Launches TLDraw Offline Skill — Live Canvas Editing
articles.summary: Optional skill reads open tldraw canvas, edits live, embeds scripts with working buttons and state. > hermes skills install optional-skills/creative/tldraw-offline

articles.title: Hermes Agent #1 on OpenRouter Global Rankings
articles.summary: Hermes Agent tops all AI apps on OpenRouter by token usage. Nearly 1,000 contributors. Dominant OSS agent ecosystem leader.

articles.title: Teknium Calls Out Distillation Hypocrisy — 'Training vs Theft' Double Standard
articles.summary: Nous Research founder satirizes double standard: US models train on everything it's 'training', Chinese learning from US is 'theft.' Viral amid escalating sanctions threats.

articles.title: Kimi Linear 48B A3B MoE Spotted — 1M Context, Fast Inference
articles.summary: New MoE variant from Moonshot AI with 48B total params and fast inference. Testers note competitive quality vs Qwen 3.6 35B with minimal output bias.

articles.title: Open-Weight AI Is Having Its Kubernetes Moment
articles.summary: Viral HN essay argues open-weight models are becoming the default AI infrastructure layer — like Linux and Kubernetes before them. 281 points, 228 comments.

articles.title: YC Fall 2026 RFS Published — Defense, AI Tutoring, Infrastructure
articles.summary: YC publishes 13 Request for Startup areas including defense technology, AI tutoring platforms, and critical infrastructure modernization for Fall 2026 batch.
